challenge.better_approach: Forwarding the caller's CAIRN_QUESTIONS_DIR and CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS from the ambient environment would be smaller. But 0c2c's tooth 4d says the account home keeps the live roots with the env set, and a root named at launch is explicit where an ambient one is not. Named roots it is.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the questions store and the artifact roots are the only roots the five lanes read. The chart lane reads berths, which launch already bends. The builder measures each lane's fixture read before writing it.
challenge.prior_art: inspect_wire.launch already bends three roots by name (ROOT_ENV, ticket 0c2c3f53c2be), and test_question_links took the same route at 8ffb98fe2. No ticket has test_question.py in bounds.in: 43875ad0eb34, c62df2454322, f99f8775482c and cd8096f9eeca mention it, and akienasus_cc_0 found none covering it.
challenge.real_collision: None. 0c2c's 4d tooth (the live roots stay with the env set) holds because the new roots bend only when named at launch.

answers.falsifier: 1) With the spawned question open, the answers lane closes the gate and the crossing raises naming cairn question answer. 2) Once it is answered, every lane reads none and the crossing goes through. 3) launch hands the questions store and artifact roots to the CodeMother it launches, and leaves them unbent when unnamed. Wrong intent if the lanes should not read a scratch world at all.
answers.from_idea: none, because the red was measured on a proof run, not an idea: cairn/tools/question/proofs/test_question.py tooth 3 (test_a_ticket_with_an_open_question_is_refused_at_buildme_and_crosses_once_answered) read red on akiendelllinux 2026-11-14 in ~/dev/src/wt-149b
answers.how: inspect_wire.launch takes the questions store and the artifact roots as named roots it hands the CodeMother it launches (beside berths, tickets_root and crossing_roots). Tooth 3's gate subprocess runs inside that launch over its scratch world, and the fixture carries what the other four lanes read: the ticket, its chart claim, intent and sorted berths, and an outline check record with ran: true.
answers.traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: a proof that measures the live commons instead of its fixture is not measuring the gate. Since 149b, the gate's lanes ask codemother over the bus, and the world the proof built never reaches her.
answers.what: test_question's tooth 3 measures the BUILDME entry gate over its own scratch world again: the CodeMother it asks reads the proof's scratch questions store and commons, so an open question closes the answers lane and an answered one lets the crossing through.

bullets.text: Since 149b, every BUILDME lane asks a launched CodeMother, and any proof that bends a root by env var alone (CAIRN_QUESTIONS_DIR, CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS) silently measures the live commons instead. test_question tooth 3 is the first one measured.
